args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money claimed to use banker's rounding per FIN-212 but quantized
with ROUND_HALF_UP, so ties like 2.665 rounded up to 2.67 instead of to
the nearest even cent (2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
tests/test_money.py passes.

args.head: fix/fin-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding, but src/money.py quantized money with ROUND_HALF_UP.

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: switched `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

## Example

- `round_money(Decimal("2.675"))` → `2.68` (unchanged, since 7 is odd and rounds up to 8)
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` → `2.66` (banker's rounding: ties go to the even cent; previously returned `2.67`)

## Testing

CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.

- **Branch**: Created `fix/fin-212-round-half-even` off main and committed the fix.
